name: Death arrow

The arrow is not stuck in the cat. The cat stays near the centre.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

The cat stays near the centre. Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image.
